address: 2500 avenue du Bugey, à Virignin, Belley, 01300, France
bio: A jaw-dropping view over the Canal du Rhône and an elegant interior set the scene in this renowned regional temple of good food. Generous portions of Ain produce take the limelight in the chef’s well-crafted score, depicted by fascinating flavour combinations and impeccable plating. Special mention for the strawberry-themed dessert that will knock the tastebuds off fans of fine French fare!...
